name: DAAD Study Scholarships for Master's in Fine Art, Design, Visual Communication and Film
coverage: Monthly stipend (€934), travel allowance, health insurance, and study/research allowance.
eligibility: Egyptian nationals and foreign applicants holding a bachelor's degree in Fine Arts, Film, Design, or Visual Communication.
notes: Selection requires a comprehensive artistic portfolio evaluated by an independent committee.

name: Chevening UK Government Scholarships for Egypt
coverage: Full university tuition, monthly living stipend, return economy flights, and visa fees.
eligibility: Egyptian citizens holding an undergraduate degree with at least 2 years of work experience in relevant creative or academic sectors.
notes: Recipients must commit to returning to Egypt for a minimum of two years post-graduation.

name: Fulbright Egyptian Student Program - Master's Degree Grant
coverage: Full tuition coverage, living allowance, health benefits, and round-trip airfare.
eligibility: Egyptian citizens residing in Egypt with a bachelor's degree in Fine Arts, Architecture, Heritage, or related disciplines.
notes: Includes dedicated support for MFA programs and Museum/Heritage Conservation studies.

name: Italian Government (MAECI) Grants for Foreign Students
fundingBody: Italian Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation
coverage: Exemption from tuition fees, health insurance coverage, and a monthly grant of €900.
eligibility: Egyptian nationals applying for Master's programs or AFAM (Higher Education in Art, Music, and Dance) academies in Italy.
notes: Covers top Italian AFAM academies specializing in Fashion Design, Restoration, and Fine Arts.

name: Eiffel Excellence Scholarship Programme
fundingBody: Campus France / French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs
coverage: Monthly allowance (€1,181 for Master's / €1,800 for PhD), international travel, health coverage, and housing support.
eligibility: Non-French candidates (including Egyptians) up to 27 years old for Master's level, nominated directly by French higher education institutions.
notes: Applications must be submitted on the candidate's behalf by an accepting French academic institution.
